sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Non-Dilutive Revenue-Based Financing for Digital Brands

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (International Company regime under the International Companies Act [CAP 222])
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: English Common Law foundation with residual French Civil Law influence; unitary national system with no sub-state tax distinction; official languages are Bislama, English and French.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No bilateral income tax treaty network in force (Vanuatu imposes no direct income tax on International Companies; statutory tax-exempt status applies instead of treaty-based relief)
Melanesian Spearhead Group (MSG) Trade Agreement (active FTA)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER) Plus (active regional FTA)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 2 of 2025 (as amended); International Companies Act [CAP 222] ss. 8-10 (name clearance), ss. 102-103 (registered office); Companies Act [CAP 191] as amended by the Companies (Amendment) Act No. 30 of 2020 (beneficial ownership transparency); VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook and Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) directives; supervised by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) and the VFIU; Vanuatu is an Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) member.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access: beneficial ownership information is filed and maintained with the VFSC and is accessible to the VFIU, Vanuatu Police, the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Service, and foreign competent authorities under mutual legal assistance frameworks; beneficial ownership details are not searchable in the public company register; the VFSC-licensed registered agent retains the UBO register in private custody.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of valid passport of each UBO, director and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority of each individual (e.g., National Passport Office or Identity Authority of domicile)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where issuer is in a Convention state; Consular Legalization at a Vanuatu diplomatic/consular post for non-Convention issuers

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clearance / certificate of good conduct for each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police or criminal-records authority of residence/domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization (for non-Hague-Convention issuers)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming account conduct, standing and no adverse AML findings (issued within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Resident bank holding the UBO's or director's active account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization; original bank letterhead and signatory verification required in all cases

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement not older than 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public utility provider or licensed bank in the UBO's/director's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization via notary public certification

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of certificate of incorporation or equivalent corporate registration record for any corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or official corporate registrar in the corporate UBO's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Signed UBO declaration and ownership structure chart with notarized signatures
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant law firm or corporate secretarial provider (prepared and notarized in the UBO's jurisdiction)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization for non-Vanuatu signatories

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Compulsory pre-onboarding and ongoing screening of all UBOs, directors and authorized signatories against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list, United Nations Security Council Consolidated Lists, UK HM Treasury, EU and Australian consolidated sanctions lists, and the VFIU domestic designation list; Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), including family members and close associates, trigger enhanced due diligence (EDD), senior-management approval, and verification of source of wealth and source of funds; transaction monitoring must cover the target payment rails (Direct_Debit_ACH and Wire_Transfer) with STR/SAR filing to the VFIU within statutory deadlines; the revenue-based financing vehicle is classified as Medium_Risk_Enhanced, requiring annual EDD review, ongoing source-of-funds verification, and a minimum 7-year record-retention period.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Name Approval and Company Registration system; applications must be submitted by a VFSC-licensed registered agent through the VFSC electronic filing/agent portal (Port Vila), reference website www.vfsc.vu.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be in Latin script (English or French); foreign-language names require certified transliteration or romanization into English or French; the name must contain a distinctive element and may not consist solely of generic or geographical terms; acceptable suffixes for an International Company include 'Limited' ('Ltd.'), 'Corporation' ('Corp.'), 'Incorporated' ('Inc.'), and French equivalents 'Société Anonyme' ('S.A.') or 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée' ('SARL'); non-Latin scripts, including Chinese characters, are not accepted in the registered name; the proposed composite token 'ROYALTY_FINANCING_FUND' must be deconstructed into natural English words and cleared as a distinctive, non-misleading descriptor.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Government / Ministry / National (when implying state connection)
Chamber of Commerce (as a suffix implying an official professional body)
Fund / Funds / Asset Management / Securities / Exchange / Clearing (requires prior VFSC written approval or a statutory exemption declaration; relevant to the intended 'ROYALTY FINANCING FUND' name)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The licensed registered agent files up to three alternative names in order of preference at the initial clearance request; upon refusal, the VFSC issues a written rejection citing the grounds under ss. 9-10 of the International Companies Act [CAP 222]; the applicant may (i) within 14 calendar days request written reasons, (ii) file a reconsideration application demonstrating non-confusion and non-sensitivity, and (iii) if still refused, submit an administrative appeal under the VFSC appeals procedure, with ultimate judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu; where a name is reserved but the company is not incorporated before expiry, a single extension of 90 days may be requested; the standard administrative reconsideration fee is approximately USD 50, payable by the agent, and simultaneous clearance of a second-choice name is strongly recommended to avoid prejudicing the incorporation timeline.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the sole registered office. Every International Company must maintain a registered office in Vanuatu at the physical premises of a VFSC-licensed registered agent under the International Companies Act [CAP 222]; virtual offices and mail-forwarding addresses may be used only as secondary correspondence addresses; for this non-licensed Medium_Risk_Enhanced royalty/revenue-based financing fund, a purely virtual arrangement would fail the VFSC incorporation requirements, weaken the commercial-substance profile expected by the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Service, and elevate the AML risk classification.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate: approximately 20% annualized probability of an unannounced physical inspection of the registered agent's premises within the first three years, plus an elevated probability of document-production orders where the VFIU flags cross-border royalty or revenue-based financing transactions; under the AML/CFT Act 2025 the VFSC may attend without notice, require production of the UBO register, share registers, consents and transactional records, and impose administrative penalties for non-compliance.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name clearance and reservation fee (up to three alternative names)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff (VFSC Schedule of Fees, payable via licensed registered agent)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International Company incorporation registration fee (standard issued capital; no minimum capital requirement)
Licensed registered agent and registered office service - first year (local registered address, company secretarial functions and statutory filings)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark in the Port Vila corporate-services market

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT compliance on-boarding package: CDD, UBO piercing, PEP and sanctions screening, risk assessment and UBO register setup
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent / AML compliance officer

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille and/or consular legalization of UBO and director KYC documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in issuer jurisdiction, competent apostille authority, or Vanuatu consular post
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark plus statutory notarial tariffs in the country of origin

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation and transliteration into English or French of any non-Latin-script documents
Corporate kit: share certificates, registers of members/directors/charges, statutory minute book and common seal
International courier and secure document dispatch (KYC bundles and apostilled originals to VFSC via agent)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Vanuatu International Companies Act 1992 (No. 12 of 1992), as amended, Sections 12–18 and 26–28
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association submitted with Form F1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a Vanuatu International Company; registered capital is declared at incorporation and shares may be issued unpaid, partly paid, or fully paid. No escrow account is mandated for an IC. The royalty financing fund must document contractual capital commitments but is not subject to any capital deposit, escrow, or paid-in requirement under Vanuatu law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the first board of directors of Vanuatu Royalty Financing Fund Inc. hereby: (i) approves and registers the subscription of 100,000 ordinary shares at USD 1.00 each, fully paid into the corporate trust account; (ii) adopts the registered agent's office in Port Vila, Efate, Vanuatu, as the Company's registered office; (iii) appoints Alexandra Smith as Director, Philip Brown as Corporate Secretary, and Emily Davis as Principal Compliance Officer, each to serve until the next annual meeting; (iv) authorizes the officers to execute all filings with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission and open banking facilities, and to undertake all ancillary actions required for lawful non-dilutive royalty financing operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage VFSC-Licensed Registered Agent and Open KYC File
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Licensed Registered Agents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a formal agency agreement with a VFSC-licensed registered agent; deliver certified KYC documentation for all shareholders, directors, and ultimate beneficial owners; the agent performs enhanced due diligence on the non-dilutive royalty financing business model and prepares a client acceptance memorandum prior to filing any incorporation documents.
required_dossiers: Certified passport copies of all directors and shareholders
Proof of residential address issued within the last 3 months
Detailed description of royalty financing activities and source of committed funds
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If KYC documentation is deemed insufficient, the applicant must supply supplementary ownership and source-of-funds evidence within 5 business days or appoint a different licensed agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation through the VFSC online company registration portal, selecting a primary and two alternate names; each name must end with 'Limited' or an approved abbreviation, and must not contain restricted words such as 'Trust', 'Bank', 'Insurance', or 'Fund' unless supported by the appropriate specialty licence; pay the name reservation fee.
required_dossiers: Corporate structure diagram showing ultimate beneficial ownership
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected as confusingly similar or prohibited, select the next available alternative name from the reservation queue and resubmit within 3 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form F1 together with the Memorandum of Association, Articles of Association, registered agent's written consent, registered office address, first director and officer appointments, and payment of the USD 250 statutory filing fee; all documents must be signed by the incorporator and, where required, notarized and legalized for international use.
required_dossiers: Consent to act of first directors and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a compliance query, the applicant must correct the specified anomalies and refile within 21 days; failure to cure within that window attracts a registry-imposed late filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain International Company Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval of the application, VFSC formally registers the company in the International Companies Register and issues the Certificate of Incorporation; verify that the certificate correctly states the company number, date of incorporation, registered agent, and registered office; retain the certificate in the corporate minute book and transmit a certified copy to the overseas fund principals.
required_dossiers: Identity verification of the person collecting the certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a typographical or jurisdiction error, lodge a written rectification request to VFSC with the original certificate; the Registry will issue a corrected certificate within 7 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Hold First Board Meeting and Execute Governance Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors / VFSC Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene a duly-noticed first board meeting, adopt the formal first board resolution approving the share subscription, registered office, and officer appointments; issue fully-paid share certificates, open and maintain the statutory share register and register of directors and officers, and deposit all minutes, consents, and registers with the registered agent at the registered office in Vanuatu.
required_dossiers: Share certificates and share transfer forms stub book
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any governance instrument is inconsistent with the filed constitutional documents, execute a corrective resolution of the board and file an amendment or rectification notice with VFSC within 14 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – non-industrial financial services entity; no manufacturing or physical production activity is associated with ISIC_6499 royalty financing funds.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable – no domestic industrial operating permit or manufacturing licence is triggered; an offshore International Company carrying on non-resident royalty financing is exempt from Vanuatu business licensing requirements, subject to maintaining a registered agent address only.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Administratively exempt – Category 4 non-industrial commercial office activity; no full or preliminary Environmental Impact Assessment is required absent physical manufacturing or resource-extraction operations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable; the entity emits no wastewater, VOCs, or hazardous waste. If a physical office is later established in Port Vila, the entity must comply with the Port Vila Municipal District wastewater discharge and solid-waste management bylaws and the Vanuatu Waste Management Regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No fire safety, structural load, or workplace clearance is required for a wholly offshore International Company without local employees, premises, or physical manufacturing footprint. Should the fund elect to establish a physical representative office, it must obtain a building occupancy permit from the Vanuatu Public Works Department and a fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services, and register any local employees with the Vanuatu National Provident Fund.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRCS), Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official national e-service portal administered at the VRCS central level.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) is statutorily outside the domestic income tax and VAT net. No TIN is required solely for incorporation or offshore activity. If the IC makes taxable domestic supplies in Vanuatu (which is generally outside the permitted IC scope) or applies for voluntary VAT registration, it must submit the VAT registration application to VRCS with the certificate of incorporation, registered office details, corporate records, director and nominee shareholder particulars, and a statement of expected taxable turnover. VRCS will issue a VAT registration number/TIN effective from the date of taxable activity. For fully offshore non-resident ICs, no TIN procurement step is mandated.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election exists because Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax. The IC's exempt status is automatic if no business is conducted within Vanuatu. A voluntary conversion from IC status to a domestic company under the Companies Act is the only statutory election that would subject the entity to local VAT and business licensing, but it is not a tax classification check-the-box mechanism.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT under the Value Added Tax Act No. 16 of 1998, as amended (Vanuatu VAT Act)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 2,000,000 in taxable supplies during any consecutive 12-month period; compulsory registration applies once the threshold is exceeded, and voluntary registration is available for lower-turnover businesses. ICs supplying services entirely to non-residents outside Vanuatu have no local VAT nexus.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not impose real-time fiscal clearance, mandatory e-invoicing, digital stamping, or transaction-level API reporting. Registered suppliers must issue serially numbered tax invoices showing the supplier's VAT registration number, date, description of supply, consideration, VAT amount, and must retain records for audit by VRCS on request.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rated supplies under the Vanuatu VAT Act include: (i) goods physically exported from Vanuatu under customs control; (ii) services directly connected with exported goods or foreign land; and (iii) services supplied to a non-resident where the benefit occurs outside Vanuatu. An IC providing revenue-based financing or royalty-financing services to non-resident digital brands is, if registered, outside the domestic supply net or eligible for zero-rating when the recipient is foreign and the funds or economic use occur offshore.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration in the approved VRCS format
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical export
Commercial Invoice and executed Royalty/Revenue-Financing Contract
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing settlement in foreign currency from the non-resident counterparty
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: There is no statutory FX repatriation deadline for a Vanuatu IC, as ICs are exempt from exchange control and may retain offshore export proceeds. However, VRCS retains audit rights to verify that exported goods or offshore services genuinely left Vanuatu or were supplied to non-residents. Fraudulent export zero-rating claims trigger a VAT reassessment at 12.5% with statutory interest, monetary penalties for false or misleading representations, criminal fines, and possible imprisonment under the Vanuatu VAT Act and Penal Code. Refunds previously paid are recoverable as tax debts with enforcement through the courts.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) as exchange control authority under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 65]; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) supervises non-bank financial services.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu vatu (VUV) is fully convertible for current account transactions. International Companies (ICs) owned by non-residents enjoy statutory exemption from exchange control restrictions on external borrowing, dividend and royalty remittances, and capital account transfers. Profit remittance to non-resident shareholders attracts no withholding tax and is freely processed by authorized dealers upon submission of audited financials, board resolutions, and standard KYC documentation. Resident entities remain subject to RBV approval for selected capital account operations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under RBV Exchange Control Notices, physical merchandise exporters must repatriate all export proceeds into a Vanuatu authorized dealer within six months of shipment date. Foreign currency receipts must be sold to an authorized dealer or credited to a foreign currency account; no fixed statutory conversion ratio applies, and conversion into VUV for local settlement occurs at prevailing interbank rates. This regime does not apply to non-exporting International Companies nor to cross-border royalty financing transactions, which are treated as invisible current payments.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. Vanuatu does not maintain a dedicated Electronic Money Institution licensing regime. Offshore digital EMIs can be used for peripheral invoice collection and disbursement in USD/EUR/GBP, but they cannot serve as the primary treasury or escrow rail because RBV exchange control policy requires foreign currency receipts and payments to be routed through a licensed authorized dealer in Vanuatu. EMIs may operate only where the funds remain offshore and no Vanuatu-clearing connection is established.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a Vanuatu International Company, directors and authorized signatories are generally required to attend an in-person KYC interview at the applicable bank's Port Vila branch, or to provide notarized and apostilled identification coupled with an approved remote video-call interview. Pure digital account opening is not accepted for ICs without a domestic registered agent's referral. The involvement of a licensed Vanuatu registered agent materially reduces the onboarding friction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk business model: revenue-based financing fund routing royalties and distributions from multi-country SPVs through Vanuatu IC.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fund operating agreement, commercial royalty and financing contracts, portfolio loan/receivable schedules, audited standalone financial statements, board resolution authorizing bank account signatories and account purpose, and a comprehensive beneficial ownership chart covering all ultimate natural-person shareholders and indirect ownership layers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large inbound capital injection from jurisdictions flagged for tax or AML opacity, without observable trade or investment underlying.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-wealth report comprising tax declarations, sale-and-purchase agreements, gift or loan instruments; bank reference from the remitting institution; SWIFT MT103 message with clear purpose code; capital commitment and drawdown schedule approved by the board; and exchange control/notional approval where required.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived shell risk: no physical office, no employees, and no locally registered assets of the Vanuatu IC.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered agent certificate, Vanuatu corporate registry extract, minutes of shareholder and board meetings, charters evidencing central management located overseas, financial statements confirming no Vanuatu operational activity, and statutory confirmation that the IC is exempt from local taxes and licensing requirements under the International Companies Act.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound equity or loan capital must be wired through a RBV-authorized bank using SWIFT MT103 with an explicit purpose narrative such as 'Equity injection into International Company' or 'Shareholder subordinated loan'. The receiving bank requires board resolutions, shareholder registry, subscription agreement, and proof of source of funds before crediting any VUV or foreign-currency account. For non-resident ICs, the injection may remain in USD, AUD, or NZD in a foreign-currency account without mandatory conversion; resident entities would require RBV exchange-control approval.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements are cleared via SWIFT MT103 for direct documentary payments, MT202 for interbank cover, or commercial letters of credit (back-to-back or confirmed by an international bank) where the revenue-based financing is used to support physical goods trade. Vanuatu banks rely on correspondent banks in Sydney, Auckland, Hong Kong, and New York for USD/AUD/NZD settlement. Direct debit and open-account rails are only available for domestic VUV transactions and cannot be used for cross-border royalty disbursement; drawdown-agreement wire transfers remain the standard.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign exchange forwards (VUV/USD, VUV/AUD, VUV/NZD) executed with an authorized Vanuatu bank
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in VUV/USD arranged through licensed international banks in Sydney or Auckland with Vanuatu bank as counter-party agent
Cross-currency swaps between VUV and USD or AUD executed under an ISDA Master Agreement with an internationally rated counterparty

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Fee Revalidation / Good Standing Renewal (International Company annual return notice)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registration & Licensing Division via licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each anniversary date of incorporation; enforceability requires full payment by the exact anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts a 10% surcharge after a 30-day grace period; non-payment for 6 consecutive months triggers VFSC strike-off and deregistration proceedings, freezing the entity's legal capacity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Register Confirmation (confidential UBO reconfirmation lodged with the annual renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC Anti-Money Laundering Unit through the licensed registered agent maintaining the Beneficial Ownership Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the incorporation anniversary date; any UBO change must additionally be notified to VFSC within 14 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or false UBO data exposes the registered agent and the company to AML administrative fines of up to VUV 10,000,000 (approx. USD 80,000), director disqualification, and eventual administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent & Registered Office Annual Renewal Endorsement (confirmation of continuous in-country representation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC via the licensed Vanuatu registered agent; the agent files a continued-consent notice supporting the annual revalidation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the anniversary annual fee payment; the agent must confirm the registered office address is current at the renewal date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a licensed registered agent and registered office is a strict statutory breach under the International Companies Act Cap 222; agent resignation without replacement results in VFSC administrative strike-off within 90 days.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None. Vanuatu International Companies are statutorily exempt from mandatory external audit and from filing audited financial statements with VFSC, regardless of revenue or balance-sheet size. A compulsory audit arises only if the entity voluntarily obtains a VFSC financial-license (e.g., banking, insurance, securities), which is not applicable for the ISIC 6499 revenue-based-financing scope.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS may be adopted voluntarily; Vanuatu has no prescribed Local GAAP for International Companies. The entity must keep accounting records that correctly explain transactions and financial position under Section 35 of the International Companies Act, retained at the registered office or another location with prior agent endorsement.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must hold a fully documented Beneficial Ownership Register for the International Company. Each anniversary, the agent sends an annual UBO confirmation certificate to the company; the company must correct or confirm the register in writing within 30 days. Material UBO changes (share transfers above 10% ownership) must be filed with VFSC within 14 days. Register access is restricted to VFSC authorized officers; no public UBO inspection is permitted for Vanuatu International Companies.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Beneficial Ownership Register (held by registered agent)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 - 1,500 per annum (bundled registered agent, registered office, and compliance officer service)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; voluntary IFRS assurance or agreed-upon-procedures report for lenders typically USD 3,000 - 8,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies (ICs) registered under the International Companies Act [CAP 222] are wholly exempt from Vanuatu corporate income tax, capital gains tax, dividend tax, and all forms of withholding tax; no VAT is chargeable on offshore-sourced financing income. The zero-rate regime is a statutory exemption, not a preferential deduction.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu. The sole statutory filing is the Annual Return under s. 99 of the International Companies Act [CAP 222], lodged electronically through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within six months after the anniversary date of incorporation; failure to lodge by the statutory date triggers late penalty fees and potential deregistration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered name of the International Company exactly as recorded in the certificate of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm exact English-language corporate name; no translation accepted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Vanuatu maintained by a VFSC-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners cannot substitute a foreign address; the Vanuatu registered agent must be identified.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and company secretary details, including names, nationality, and residential addresses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; a physical Vanuatu address must still be provided for service of process.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Shareholder register summary and issued share capital, including classes of shares and beneficial ownership declaration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: 100% non-resident ownership is lawful; disclose ultimate beneficial owners in compliance with the VFSC register requirements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on domestic business with Vanuatu residents, has not held land in Vanuatu, and remains outside the scope of the domestic tax and Companies Act regime.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A cross-border royalty financing fund must confine activities to offshore sources; domestic dealings would void the IC exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual return fee confirmation and electronic payment reference.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Settlement by wire transfer from the registered agent's escrow account is standard for non-resident principals.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of VUV 50,000 for each overdue year, additional monthly default surcharges, loss of good standing certificate, and striking-off/deregistration under the International Companies Act after statutory notice.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu imposes no domestic withholding tax on outbound dividends, so no statutory reduction is required. Where a limited double tax agreement applies, the non-resident recipient must obtain a Vanuatu Tax Residency Certificate from the VFSC (confirming tax-exempt IC status) and present it to the foreign payer to invoke treaty benefits; the VFSC certificate is the sole administrative instrument, and no dedicated DTA relief form exists in Vanuatu domestic law.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% for both IP royalties and debt interest paid by a Vanuatu IC. Treaty rate: effectively nil under Vanuatu's narrow DTA network; absence of domestic WHT means treaty relief is redundant for outbound payments.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no codified transfer pricing documentation rules, no Local File or Master File thresholds, and no thin capitalization limitation for tax purposes. An IC engaged in royalty financing is nonetheless subject to VFSC prudential oversight and must maintain contractual records supporting the arm's length nature of cross-border transactions.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance Regulations Act No. 37 of 2019 applies to ICs undertaking 'relevant activities', including financing and leasing, intellectual property holding, and fund management. A royalty financing fund must demonstrate in Vanuatu: (i) board meetings and strategic management held in-country, (ii) adequate physical office and qualified staff, and (iii) core income-generating activities performed in Vanuatu. Failure attract fines and deregistration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC as a pure booking vehicle, declaring all income offshore while the real management, treasury decision-making, and royalty-financing negotiations occur in the foreign market of the beneficial owner, with the purpose of evading foreign corporate tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Domestic: loss of the IC tax-exempt status, retroactive assessment at the corporate income tax headline rate applicable to non-exempt entities, derecognition of the company under s. 13 of the ICA, and deregistration by the VFSC. Foreign: countervailing tax reassessment, CFC attribution, and penalty regimes of the investor's home jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow directors may be held personally liable for restitution of avoided taxes, subject to director disqualification orders, cross-border tax information exchange under the VFSC's exchange mandates, and travel-bank/criminal extradition risk where intentional evasion is shown.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Abuse / Defective Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Holding a passive royalty stream or financing receivables with zero Vanuatu operational presence, no local employees, no office, and no locally initiated board decisions while invoking the 0% tax regime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil and administrative penalty under the Economic Substance Regulations Act of up to VUV 5,000,000 for the first year of default, additional periodic penalties of up to VUV 1,000,000 per month for continuing default, and mandatory deregistration of the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve or tolerate the substance gap are jointly and severally liable for the statutory penalties; the court may order sequestration of personal assets, director disqualification for a fixed term, and immigration restrictions preventing re-entry to Vanuatu.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Breach and Financial Intelligence Non-Compliance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a revenue-based financing fund collecting ACH direct debits and wire transfers from digital-brand borrowers without implementing a risk-based AML programme, conducting customer due diligence, or filing suspicious transaction reports with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal sanctions under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act: fine of up to VUV 10,000,000 and/or imprisonment of up to 15 years for failure to report, tipping-off, or facilitating money laundering; in addition the VFSC can revoke the IC's registration and the registered agent's licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and controlling shareholders face criminal imprisonment, personal fines, confiscation of proceeds under the Proceeds of Crime Act, and travel bans imposed by the Vanuatu courts pending investigation; private civil suits by defrauded lenders may pierce the corporate veil on 'sham' grounds.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Financial Services / Deposit-Taking Outside IC Scope
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring the 'non-dilutive financing fund' to accept deposits, redeemable notes, or repayable advances from the general public, or conducting securities dealing, without a financial dealer licence under the Financial Dealers Act 2019 or a banking licence under the Banking Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties against the IC including fine of up to VUV 10,000,000; forced winding-up; repayment of all unauthorised deposits; permanent loss of the IC exemption for breach of the domestic business prohibition in the International Companies Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal criminal liability, imprisonment, and civil liability for all investor losses; the VFSC may issue a public warning, seek a freezing order over personal assets, and impose a travel ban while civil/substantive proceedings are pending.
